title: Slowdown severity spectrum
notes: Continuous slowdown severity = distance-weighted mean of positive second-half DoS (DoS<=0 → 0). Ordinal bands: none [0,0.10); mild [0.10,0.25); moderate [0.25,0.40); severe >=0.40. Computed via gap_substrate.severity.compute_severity; Smyth htw binary flag is never overwritten. Full corpus (not majors-only sample).
method: gap_substrate.severity.compute_severity on full features.parquet; no weather API
answer_prose: Across 2,512,860 eligible finishers in the current dump, continuous slowdown severity (distance-weighted mean of positive second-half slowdown) averages 0.117 (median 0.090). Band mix: none 53.9%, mild 35.2%, moderate 8.7%, severe 2.1%. Binary sustained slowdown stays separate: severity fills the spectrum below the paper threshold while keeping Smyth’s flag untouched.
methodology_prose: Severity uses gap_substrate.severity.compute_severity on the Analyst feature dump: second-half segment DoS (pace vs reference pace from 5–20 km), negatives floored at 0, then distance-weighted mean. Bands: none [0,0.10), mild [0.10,0.25), moderate [0.25,0.40), severe ≥0.40. Smyth binary sustained slowdown (s=0.25, d=5 km after 20 km) unchanged. Tables use valid_splits only (n_features=3,167,990). No invented weather/elev; race_records untouched.

ux.note: Sight must not invent copy; numbers from Analyst dumps only.

presentation_revision.scope: Terminology and labels only; numerical values, input dates and calculation provenance retained.
